SELECT MAX(handle.id) AS groupLinkId, handle.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.subject), '')), MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.display_name), ''))) AS groupName, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(legacy_preview.owner_phone), '')) AS ownerPhone, MAX(CASE WHEN current_profile.wa_created_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE FLOOR(current_profile.wa_created_at / 1000) END) AS groupCreatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.checked_member_count), MAX(current_profile.member_count)) AS memberSize, MAX(current_profile.announce_only) AS announceOnly, MAX(current_group.avatar_url) AS avatarUrl, GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.metadata_observed_at), 0), COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.last_checked_at), 0), COALESCE(MAX(binding.last_observed_at), 0)) AS lastSyncedAt, MAX(current_profile.health_status) AS healthStatus, MAX(current_profile.banned) AS banned, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.last_error_code), '')) AS healthError, MAX(CASE WHEN handle.is_historical = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS historical, MAX(CASE WHEN jr.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS selfCollected, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN self_participant.role IN (2, 3) OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN a.id END) AS adminRelationCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.account_state = 2 AND (self_participant.role IN (2, 3) OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')) THEN a.id END) AS eligibleAccountCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.account_state = 2 AND s.login_state = 1 AND (self_participant.role IN (2, 3) OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')) THEN a.id END) AS onlineAccountCount, MAX(jr.join_task_id) AS sourceJoinTaskId, MAX(jr.join_task_name) AS sourceJoinTaskName, MAX(jr.joined_at) AS sourceJoinedAt, MAX(jr.promoted_at) AS sourcePromotedAt, MAX(o.occupancy_type) AS occupancyType, MAX(o.reservation_token) AS reservationToken, MAX(o.task_id) AS occupiedTaskId, MAX(o.task_name_snapshot) AS occupiedTaskName, MAX(o.created_by) AS occupiedBy, MAX(o.last_validated_at) AS lastValidatedAt, MAX(o.last_validation_reason) AS lastValidationReason FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id AND current_group.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND a.id = binding.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id INNER JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND handle.group_id = binding.group_id AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = binding.group_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked.tenant_id, ranked.group_jid, ranked.join_task_id, ranked.join_task_name, ranked.owner_user_id, ranked.joined_at, ranked.promoted_at, ranked.id FROM ( SELECT r.tenant_id, r.group_jid, r.join_task_id, t.name AS join_task_name, t.owner_user_id, r.joined_at, r.promoted_at, r.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.tenant_id, r.group_jid, t.owner_user_id ORDER BY COALESCE(r.promoted_at, r.joined_at), r.id ) AS source_rank FROM join_task_result r INNER JOIN join_task t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND t.id = r.join_task_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.is_admin = 1 ) ranked WHERE ranked.source_rank = 1 ) jr ON jr.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND jr.group_jid = current_group.group_jid AND (jr.owner_user_id = handle.owner_user_id OR (jr.owner_user_id IS NULL AND handle.owner_user_id IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN pull_task_group_marketing_group_occupancy o ON o.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND o.group_jid = current_group.group_jid AND o.released_at IS NULL WHERE binding.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (a.owner_user_id = handle.owner_user_id OR (a.owner_user_id IS NULL AND handle.owner_user_id IS NULL))
AND (handle.is_historical = 1 OR jr.id IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wa_account_group_binding filter_binding INNER JOIN wa_group_participant filter_participant ON filter_participant.tenant_id = filter_binding.tenant_id AND filter_participant.group_id = filter_binding.group_id AND filter_participant.id = filter_binding.participant_id AND filter_participant.presence_status = 1 INNER JOIN account fa ON fa.tenant_id = filter_binding.tenant_id AND fa.id = filter_binding.account_id AND fa.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN account_state fs ON fs.tenant_id = fa.tenant_id AND fs.account_id = fa.id AND fs.account_state = 2 INNER JOIN group_link filter_handle ON filter_handle.tenant_id = filter_binding.tenant_id AND filter_handle.group_id = filter_binding.group_id AND filter_handle.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview filter_preview ON filter_preview.tenant_id = filter_handle.tenant_id AND filter_preview.group_link_id = filter_handle.id WHERE filter_binding.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND filter_binding.group_id = binding.group_id AND (filter_handle.owner_user_id = handle.owner_user_id OR (filter_handle.owner_user_id IS NULL AND handle.owner_user_id IS NULL)) AND (fa.owner_user_id = filter_handle.owner_user_id OR (fa.owner_user_id IS NULL AND filter_handle.owner_user_id IS NULL)) AND (filter_participant.role IN (2, 3) OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fa.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(filter_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', ''))
AND fa.ws_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.managerPhone}, '%')
AND fa.account_group_id = #{query.accountGroupId}
)
GROUP BY current_group.group_jid, handle.owner_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT candidate.* FROM () candidate WHERE ORDER BY candidate.groupJid ASC, candidate.ownerUserId ASC, candidate.groupLinkId ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT handle.id AS groupLinkId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone, CASE WHEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN 'CREATOR' ELSE 'ADMIN' END AS groupRole, s.login_state AS loginState, s.account_state AS accountState, binding.last_observed_at AS lastSeenAt FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id AND current_group.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND a.id = binding.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id AND s.account_state = 2 INNER JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND handle.group_id = binding.group_id AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id WHERE handle.id IN
#{groupLinkId}
AND (a.owner_user_id = handle.owner_user_id OR (a.owner_user_id IS NULL AND handle.owner_user_id IS NULL))
AND (self_participant.role IN (2, 3) OR REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '')) ORDER BY handle.id ASC, CASE WHEN s.login_state = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(binding.last_observed_at, 0) DESC, a.id ASC
